helpers.name: link_files_to_task

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: ID of the task, subtask, or sidequest

helpers.purpose: Link files to a task, subtask, or sidequest (task_files junction) so get_task_context and get_task_files return them. Files are linked automatically when reserved, finalized, cataloged, or updated (and when their functions/types are finalized, cataloged, or updated) while a work item is in_progress — the most recent in_progress sidequest, else subtask, else task. Use this for files worked on before the item was in_progress, or to correct a link.
helpers.error_handling: Returns error if file_ids is empty, task_type is invalid, the work item does not exist, or any file ID is not found. Existing links are skipped, not errors.
return_statements: Verify with get_task_context(task_id, task_type) that files[] now lists every file this work touched.
implementation_notes: INSERT OR IGNORE into task_files (reference_table, reference_id, file_id)
Auto-linking helpers share link_files_to_current_focus_effect in the same module; it is best-effort and never fails the tracking call

used_by_directives.description: Before completion: link any files worked on outside the in_progress window so the get_task_context gate sees them

helpers.name: unlink_files_from_task

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: ID of the task, subtask, or sidequest

helpers.purpose: Remove file links from a task, subtask, or sidequest — e.g. a file auto-linked to the wrong in_progress item. Does not touch the files.
helpers.error_handling: Returns error if file_ids is empty, task_type is invalid, or the work item does not exist. Links that do not exist are counted as skipped.
return_statements: If the file belongs to a different work item, link it there with link_files_to_task.
